# IATA.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v6) with a 12-month target of Rp95.0 against Rp71.0 (expected total return 33.3%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: dividend_income_anchor · method card: per fund record routing for Coal producers.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- The bridge's largest positive item, USD38.77m (Rp22.4/share, 20% of the Rp110 target), is one-half of the USD77.54m mining-property/E&E line allocated by licence count (three of six). S12 Note 11 splits that line: mining
- The published target Rp110.34 is, on the analyst's own arithmetic, about 19% below the corrected probability-weighted value Rp136.52 (base 121.28, bear 63.42, bull 284.30) because the engine re-bases the shocked deck ins
- The claim that the float is under a fifth (summary, s1, s6) is contradicted by the pack's own IDX registry free_float_pct of 44.06% (2026-11-04) and insider_pct 66.62%. S16 shows the controller moved from 60.35% to 62.47

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
